content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes that the A1C test, fasting plasma glucose (FPG) test, and 2-hour plasma glucose (2-h PG) test each provide unique insights into different aspects of glucose metabolism. The results of these tests can vary depending on individual characteristics and population-specific factors. Furthermore, the ADA highlights that the use of different diagnostic thresholds may identify separate groups of individuals at varying levels of risk for diabetes or related conditions.
